answer_1.quote: Automatic text summarization is the process of outputting the most salient parts of an input in a concise and readable form.

answer_2.quote: We see ROUGE improvements when applying BART-arggraph for Reddit, and Stack data.

answer_4.quote: We collect human judgment annotations for two of the four quality dimensions studied in ... and ..., namely consistency and relevance.
answer_4.guideline: The annotator sees the source article and randomly-ordered output from the model and then rates the summaries for relevance and consistency on a Likert from 1 to 5, with 5 being the best score.
